title: Formal Conjectures (Open Research): Erdős Problems in Number Theory
description: Twenty-five genuinely open Erdős number theory conjectures (two-sided prove-or-refute targets via POST .../submit or POST .../refute) extracted verbatim from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures@5bd8bfb9 (Apache-2.0) and cross-referenced as open & unformalized in teorth/erdosproblems. Includes the $250 Erdős–Szemerédi sum-product conjecture (#52), odd weird numbers (#470), consecutive equal totients (#1003), central binomials coprime to 105 (#376), squarefree + 2^l representations (#11), and irrationality of ∑ p_n/2^n (#251).

tasks.description: Verbatim statement `erdos_52` from `FormalConjectures/ErdosProblems/52.lean#L37-L39` (`category research open`). Two-sided open conjecture: submit a Lean 4 proof of `T` via `POST .../submit` or a kernel-checked disproof of `¬ T` via `POST .../refute`.
